features.name: Shared mode access to color, depth and infrared frame sources
features.description: Displays color, depth and infrared frame sources simultaneously in shared mode, with a 'Next Source Group' button to cycle source groups and a status log.
expected_behaviour: Page shows a Description block and a 'Next Source Group' button
Three labelled preview regions are present: Color frame source, Depth frame source, Infrared frame source
A status/log line reports source-group state (e.g. 'No source groups found.' when no camera is present)
Clicking 'Next Source Group' cycles the active source group (produces a visible response)

features.name: Find and display all media frame sources
features.description: Enumerates frame sources and initializes a selected source via a frame reader. Provides Source Group, Frame Source and Media Format selectors plus Start/Stop controls.
expected_behaviour: Three ComboBoxes are present: Source Group, Frame Source, Media Format
Start and Stop buttons are present
Start/Stop are disabled until a valid source group/source is selected (hardware-gated; both disabled when 'No source groups found')
